## WhatsApp Appointment Reminder

- **Building block, not a scheduler.** Something else (a Cron/Schedule Trigger elsewhere, or your own polling job) must call this sub-workflow once per candidate appointment -- it does not read a calendar or database itself and has no trigger of its own beyond Execute Workflow.
- **No idempotency protection.** This workflow is stateless: invoking it twice with the same due appointment sends the reminder twice. The caller must track which appointments already got a reminder.
- **No calendar/database read or write of any kind.** All appointment data arrives as input parameters.
